sections.text_helper: Section 23.2 "COMP main features" in chapter 23 (Comparator (COMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 711.
sections.section_content:
• Selectable inverting analog inputs:
– I/O pins
– DAC channel outputs
– Internal reference voltage and three submultiple values (1/4, 1/2, 3/4) provided by
the scaler (buffered voltage divider)
• I/O pins selectable as noninverting analog inputs
• Programmable hysteresis
• Programmable speed/consumption
• Mapping of outputs to I/Os
• Redirection of outputs to timer inputs for triggering:
– Capture events
– OCREF_CLR events (for cycle-by-cycle current control)
– Break events for fast PWM shutdowns
• Blanking of comparator outputs
• Interrupt generation capability with wake up from Sleep and Stop modes (through the
EXTI controller)
• Interrupt output through the EXTI controller
• Direct interrupt output to the CPU
• Window mode
